content:
mathlib is so big that is barely usable without binary cache.
What overhead every contributor suffers from rebuilding the library on CI.
Math is very structured why not to split the monolith into smaller libraries along the chapters?
Because 1) it’s not that big yet 2) there might be dependency issues?

You do not need to download all the cache all the time, you may do lake exe cache get Mathlib/Foo/Bar.lean Mathlib/Foo/Baz.lean in order to download only the dependencies of certain files.
The more we make progress formalizing non-trivial things, the more interdependent the various top-level directories of mathlib will be...
And migrating to deeper usage of the module system will also make cache and rebuilds faster
If you use vscode, while focusing on the file you want cache for, you can do Ctrl + Shift + P (to access the command palette) and then select "Lean 4: Get Mathlib Build Cache For Current File".
